bots.title: Austin Parent Bot
bots.description: Family chief of staff for Austin parents: school, calendar, activities, and household logistics.

bots.title: Austen Bot
bots.description: Speak as Jane Austen's social intelligence — manners, money, marriage plots, irony. Needle gently; converse sharply.

bots.title: Audiovisual Bot
bots.description: Turns copy briefs into Instagram carousel and static art in a photo-on-top layout.

bots.title: ASC Skill Bot
bots.description: Teaches App Store Connect in plain words: connect a key, check TestFlight, draft listing copy, framed screenshots you approve, and a pre-review checklist.

bots.title: Article Access Bot
bots.description: Paste a DOI, PMID, or citation. Gets the open-access copy, your library proxy link, and the publisher page — in that order. Never invents access.

bots.title: Arthur Bot
bots.description: Children’s book author. Give a topic and age range; it writes a complete picture book, briefs an illustrator teammate, and saves the draft.

bots.title: Arnold Bot
bots.description: Friendly accountant for Cursor token spend. Watches runaway processes, steers other agents model choices as usage rises, and lets you dial alert noise.

bots.title: Argubot
bots.description: Runs adversarial claim bouts: steelman vs dissent on whatever claim you plug in. One job only.

bots.title: Arch Shorts Bot
bots.description: Solo YouTube Shorts maker for architecture and civil-engineering explainers: script, Imagine cuts, dubbing, and mux — delivers the finished short.

bots.title: Apps Bot
bots.description: One-shots a live Vite + React + TypeScript + Convex app from a single sentence.

bots.title: Appeal Desk Bot
bots.description: Reads an insurance denial, names the kind, finds the deadline, and drafts the appeal for you to file. Not medical or legal advice.

bots.title: App Store Review Bot
bots.description: Audits iOS apps before App Review and guides rejection response. Built from 300+ rejections.

bots.title: AMV Desk Bot
bots.description: Hybrid AMV studio desk for YouTube/X/Patreon: paper to lock song to stills to I2V swarm to polish to Drive review link. Human decides; the desk produces.

bots.title: Ambassador Watch Bot
bots.description: Watches the Cursor (and SpaceXAI if separate) ambassador application channel: page up, form/submit open, and changes worth acting on.

bots.title: Amazing Randibot
bots.description: A skeptical investigator in James Randi’s tradition. Stress-tests claims with outside evidence, not memory or vibes, and pokes holes with good-natured sarcasm.

bots.title: AI Master Bot
bots.description: Sends each question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok in the browser, then returns one combined summary so you do not copy-paste across four chats.

bots.title: Agent Manager Bot
bots.description: Reviews your Grok agent roster for overlaps, quiet desks, and keep/improve/cut proposals with evidence. Propose only; never deletes agents.

bots.title: AEO SEO Bot
bots.description: Weekday content OS for an SEO and AEO team: mines about 40 candidates, you pick 20, pages stay unpublished until an exact yes.

bots.title: Adventure Bot
bots.description: Drops one GPS pin sized to your time and vibe, then learns what you actually liked so the next pick gets sharper.

bots.title: Adie Bot
bots.description: Life orchestrator for ADHD, anxiety, and depression friction — warm accountability chat, deep assistance, and gentle routines (eat, meds, birthdays). Not a therapist.

bots.title: Action Loop Bot
bots.description: Closes open loops: action, feedback, adjustment, action again.

bots.title: Accountant Bot
bots.description: Watches a Grok Bot fleet for runaway tokens: over-polling, retry loops, empty stubs. Ranked table, drafts only.

bots.title: 4 Panez Bot
bots.description: Paints one ultra-wide 16:9 scene, splits it into four swipe panes, and delivers it with rapper energy.

bots.title: Chief
bots.description: A Chief of Staff that scans email and calendar every weekday morning, archives junk, drafts replies it never sends, and hands you a one-page brief of what matters and what you must decide.
